title: Compute a reproducible sum
description: Sum the public fixture [2,3,5] and provide the result and a reproduction command.

work.goal: Compute the exact sum of [2,3,5] and include a reproducible command that verifies it.

outputs.description: The sum and a command that reproduces the calculation.

acceptance.criteria: The buyer independently checks the sum against [2,3,5] and runs or inspects the reproduction command.
